the_canonical_sentence.verbatim: The main goal now is to relate these two kinds of isomorphisms: the one arising from q and the one arising from anabelian methods. Concretely, we wish to show that there exists some suitable S such that / eta_q = eta^anab_S . (9-1)
the_canonical_sentence.reading: Q(9-1)  ==  [D and the input BPS fixed]  ->  EXISTS S  ( eta_q = eta^anab_S ).
the_canonical_sentence.why_this_is_the_canonical_one: It is the only place in the fixed cache where (9-1) is written as a sentence with an explicit existential. Everything else in the ledger is stated relative to this sentence.

quantifier_chain.order_sentence: first fix the initial Theta-data and the input BPS (and, in the Lean form, the pair of Hodge theaters together with the Theta-link); only then EXISTS the isomorphism iota of Step 1; only then EXISTS the (Ind3)-choice S; the goal is the equation eta_q = eta^anab_S for that one pair (iota, S).
quantifier_chain.hard_requirement: The order must be 'fix input/iota, then exists S'. 'There exists an S' must not be restated as 'invariant for all S'.
hard_requirement_evidence: LANA p.46: 'there exists some suitable S such that' - explicit existential plus the restrictive qualifier 'suitable'.

LANA p.45-46: the Step 1 isomorphism is fixed BEFORE the S-dependent construction ('after fixing an isomorphism between a given BPS and the Theta-BPS' / 'Once we fix S'), so iota precedes S and S precedes the equation.
Lean: Iut/Wall/EtaAlg.lean:174-175 has binder order forall (h1 h2 gl), exists (iota) (S), etaAnab iota S = etaQ D - the forall is OUTSIDE the exists, and iota is bound before S.

The rejected reading does not even occur in the paper: in the Cor. 3.12 statement of IUT III pp.173-174 the letter S does not occur at all (bare-capital-S scan over L10498-10597 returns only the 'S^{+-}_{j+1}' inside IQ(...) at L10553, L10574, L10581), so the paper cannot be quoted for a forall over S either.

paper_objects.eta_anab_S: the isomorphism R^val -> R^ss built by anabelian methods with S as the integral structure; it depends on S ('Thus the isomorphism ... depends on S')
paper_objects.R_ss: {T subset VC(I_v) | adelic and measurable}/~, with T ~ T' iff their volumes coincide

target_eta_equation.equation_is_one_scalar_equation: Because a value-group BPS is a pointed real line, a pointed linear map out of it is determined by the image of the pilot (BPS.lean:329-332 eta_unique, BPS.lean:335-340 eta_eq_eta_iff). So (9-1) is equivalent to ONE real-number equation, not to a family of equations.

allowed_choice_S.paper_type: S subset VC(I_v): an adelic, measurable subset of the log-shell version of the large volume container

paper_root_of_the_existential.wording: (Ind3) ... it is not possible to reconstruct VC(O) ... All we can say is that this is an adelic measurable subset of the log-shell version of the volume container (upper-semi compatibility). Therefore, instead of just VC(O), we must take into account all such subsets.
paper_root_of_the_existential.why_it_matters: 'All we can say' is a bound on what is known, so the goal can only ask for ONE such subset to work. It is a limitation, not an invariance claim.

paper_family_form.wording: the possible images of the Theta-pilot object are obtained as LGP·U subset VC(I) x Q, where U ranges over suitable subsets of the large volume container VC(I)
paper_family_form.why_it_matters: The possible images form a family indexed by U; (9-1) asks whether some member of that family matches eta_q.

allowed_choice_S.lean_type: {S : Region D // IsAdelic D S ∧ ∀ i, S i ≤ hullOf D (vcI D) i}

deviation_from_paper.stated_in_source: Lean takes S inside the HOLOMORPHIC HULL of VC(I); LANA takes S inside VC(I)
deviation_from_paper.source_wording: **Deviation (deliberate): (Ind3) ranges over the hull.** [LANA], §6 takes `S ⊆ VC(I)`. Here `S ⊆ hull(VC(I))`.
deviation_from_paper.quantifier_effect: Under the hull reading the candidate family is LARGER, so 'exists S' is a STRONGER requirement (harder), not a weaker one. Both readings keep the shape EXISTS S; neither becomes a FORALL. This audit records the deviation and does not adjudicate which reading the original proof uses (see unresolved U3).

inhabitedness.fact: Nonempty (Ind3 D) holds; Ind3.top is the hull and Ind3.base is VC(I).
inhabitedness.what_it_does_not_say: It says the type of candidates is nonempty. It says nothing about whether a *suitable* S exists - that is exactly (9-1), and it is open (U1).

logVolume_range.fact: the log-volumes of the (Ind3)-choices are exactly {x | x <= logVol(hull(VC(I)))}

paper_level_reading_of_the_same_step.claim: Corollary 3.12 fixes the input and concludes that the FIXED value -|log(q)| lies in the set of POSSIBLE output log-volumes - a membership / existential over the output family, not an equality on all outputs.
paper_level_reading_of_the_same_step.caveat: Corollary 3.12 does not itself contain the letter S, nor the equation eta_q = eta^anab_S. The S-form is LANA's reconstruction of the step from Theorem 3.11 to Corollary 3.12. Reading the S-form back into Mochizuki's text would be an over-attribution (U2).

forbidden_forms.statement: 'There exists an S' must not be written as 'invariant for all S'.
forbidden_forms.forbidden_form_1: ∀ S : Ind3 D, etaAnab ι S = etaQ D
forbidden_forms.why_forbidden: The paper says 'exists some suitable S'; (Ind3) is an upper-semi-compatibility limitation, so only SOME S is claimed. The Lean wall has exists where the forbidden forms have forall.
forbidden_forms.scan_result: 0 hits in all three files (run by T097_audit.py; see logs/). The forbidden prose form does not occur in the pinned cache.

where_a_forall_over_S_legitimately_appea.what: EtaAlg.LGPLaw (T4): ∃ κ, ∀ S, logVol (out ι S) = κ + logVol S.1 - a strengthening about the whole family; the wall derived from it is still ∃ ι, not ∀ S.
T1 ind12_acts_on_S: ∃ τ, ∀ S, out ((mk α).trans ι) S = out ι (τ S) - a symmetry of the family, no equation with etaQ.
T2 etUnitOnly: ∃ f, ∀ ..., out ι S = f ι.et S - a structural field.
C2 SHESides: ∀ (h1 h2 ι S), out ι S = F h1 S ∧ out ι S = G h2 S - expressibility, no equation with etaQ.
C6 Multiradial: ∃ τ, ∀ S, out ι S = out ι' (τ S) - relabelling of S, no equation with etaQ.
C9 SetTransport: ∃ φ, ∀ ι S, out ι S = φ S.1 - set-theoretic transport, no equation with etaQ.

IUT III p.156 (Ind3): 'as one varies m in Z, the isomorphisms of (a) are upper semi-compatible ... involves certain natural inclusions' - one-sided, hence membership/inequality rather than equality over all choices.
